name: Ettore Bugatti
features: olive skin, dark hair, brown eyes, well-groomed mustache, dapper appearance, artistic features, distinguished look
bio: Ettore Arco Isidoro Bugatti was an Italian-born French automobile designer and manufacturer. He founded the Bugatti brand, producing some of the most beautiful and fastest cars of the pre-war era. Though primarily an engineer, he occasionally competed in races.
